verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven formation and compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only per-item Partner API calls (create customers, submit formations, file annual reports) and per-request idempotency, with no batch or bulk endpoint and no multi-item action. Scripting many individual API calls would be a developer building block, not the product's own bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
